documents.title: Policy 100-022: Howard University Artificial Intelligence (AI) Policy
documents.stance_why: Policy 100-022 is a university-wide framework. It sets no ban or permission itself; section V.C says 'Faculty shall establish and communicate, through course syllabi... whether and how AI may be used in coursework', and students must follow course requirements. That hands the decision to instructors, so delegates.
documents.summary: University-wide AI policy (effective April 2026) from the Provost. It sets data, disclosure, accountability and research rules for everyone and leaves classroom AI rules to faculty syllabi, with students told to ask when a syllabus is silent. Violations lead to disciplinary action under existing policies.
